treatments.name: 1 Week 1 Kilo

bench.time: Weekly visits for 3 months or more
bench.desc: A weekly program prescribed by the doctor that works on the hunger that rises when you eat less.

note.h: Why weight comes back after a diet
note.p: Dieting changes your hunger hormones, and in one study they were still changed a year later.

treatments.desc: 1 Week 1 Kilo at Apex Slim and Longevity is a weight-loss program where you see the doctor every week and the plan is adjusted around your hunger.
hook: Most people who lose weight on a diet put some of it back on. A 2011 study in the New England Journal of Medicine found that after a diet, the body makes more ghrelin, the hormone that makes you hungry, and less of the hormones that tell you you're full.

The 50 people in that study lost an average of 13.5 kg over 10 weeks. A year later their hormones still hadn't gone back to normal and they still felt hungrier than before they started. 1 Week 1 Kilo is our weight-loss program for people who regain weight after dieting. You see the doctor every week, and the plan is adjusted around your hunger as well as your weight.

protocol.v: Once a week with the doctor
Body composition scan, BMI and waist on the Asian scale, and your goals
At least 3 months
Weight often starts to drop in 2 to 4 weeks
BMI 30 or more, or overweight with a related condition such as diabetes or high blood pressure
None

treatments.body:
What happens to your hunger after a diet

Leptin is a hormone your fat tissue makes. It tells your brain how much energy you have stored. When you lose fat, your leptin level drops and your brain reacts as if food were running short. Your stomach then makes more ghrelin and your gut makes less of the hormones that make you feel full after eating.

In the NEJM study these changes were still there at 62 weeks, more than a year after the diet started. Since the changes last, eating less on your own gets harder the longer you keep it up.

The Asian BMI scale

A WHO expert panel found in 2004 that Asian people carry more body fat than Europeans at the same BMI and get diabetes and heart disease at a lower BMI. Since Asian people carry more fat at the same BMI, Thailand uses 23 as the cut-off for overweight and 25 for obese, while many Western charts use 25 and 30.

The doctor also measures your waist since it shows where the fat is. A waist of 90 cm or more in men or 80 cm or more in women means more fat around the organs, and so does a waist more than half your height. You can check your BMI and waist in the Wellness Lab before you come in.

How the program works

  1. At the first visit the doctor goes through your health, your weight history and your body composition scan.
  2. You agree on a goal with the doctor. The first goal is usually 5 to 10 percent of your body weight since losing that much already improves blood pressure and blood sugar.
  3. If the doctor prescribes medicine to control your hunger, you start on the lowest dose. The dose goes up slowly to keep side effects down.
  4. You get an eating plan to follow at home and a target for how much water to drink each day.
  5. You come back every week to weigh in and talk about your hunger and any side effects. The doctor adjusts the plan from there.
  6. Exercise is added over time until you reach 150 to 300 minutes a week.

Weekly visits

Every visit starts with your weight and waist. The doctor asks how hungry you've been and what you ate, then changes one or two things for the next week. You also get a body composition scan at set points in the program to see how much of what you lost is fat and how much is water or muscle.

Who can't join

The doctor won't start the program, or will leave the medicine out, if you:

  • are pregnant, breastfeeding or planning a pregnancy
  • have a family history of medullary thyroid cancer or a hormone gland tumour
  • have had pancreatitis
  • have severe stomach, bowel, liver or kidney disease
  • have severe depression

Side effects

The medicine can cause nausea, bloating, vomiting, constipation or diarrhoea, most often in the first few weeks and after the dose goes up. They usually get better as your body gets used to it. Losing weight fast can also cause gallstones. Tell the doctor straight away if you get strong pain in the upper right part of your stomach.

What to bring to your first visit

  • the medicines and supplements you take
  • blood test results from the past year if you have them
  • your weight history, including any diets you've tried and how much weight came back

faq.q: Will I lose 1 kilo every week?
faq.a: That's the pace the program aims for. Weight often starts to drop in 2 to 4 weeks, and the doctor keeps the pace at what's safe for you.

faq.q: Do I have to give up foods I like?
faq.a: No food is banned. The eating plan sets portions you can keep up for months.
Yes. CoolSculpting removes fat from one area but barely changes your weight, so the doctor often starts you on 1 Week 1 Kilo and treats the stubborn area once you're close to your goal.

faq.q: What happens when the program ends?
faq.a: The doctor plans the end of the program with you. Keep up the eating and exercise habits from the weekly visits since your hunger hormones can stay changed for more than a year.

treatments.name: CoolSculpting

bench.desc: Cools a fold of fat until the fat cells in it die, and you go back to work the same day.

note.p: Fat cells freeze at a warmer temperature than skin, so cooling the skin can kill the fat under it.

treatments.desc: CoolSculpting at Apex Slim and Longevity takes 35 to 75 minutes per area. You can go back to work the same day and see the full result at 3 months.
hook: CoolSculpting removes fat from one area of the body without needles or cuts by cooling it until the fat cells die. It's for the fat that won't go away with diet and exercise, like the lower belly, the love handles or the fold under a bra strap.

Doctors at Harvard came up with the idea after reports of children getting a small dent in the cheek from sucking on ice pops. They found that fat cells freeze at a warmer temperature than skin, and in 2008 they showed it on pigs by cooling the skin and destroying the fat underneath without harming the skin.

protocol.v: CoolSculpting Elite, cooling to -11 to -13 °C
35 to 75 minutes per area
Often 1 per area, with a repeat after 8 to 12 weeks for a clearer result
Back to work the same day
Redness, swelling, numbness or tingling that mostly fade in 1 to 2 weeks
First changes at 4 weeks, clearest at 2 to 3 months
BellyFlanksInner thighsOuter thighsUpper armsUnder the chinBra lineBackHipsUnder the buttocks

treatments.body:
Results from studies

A 2015 review in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery looked at 19 studies on fat freezing. The fat layer in the treated area was 14.7 to 28.5 percent thinner when measured with calipers and 10.3 to 25.5 percent thinner on ultrasound. Most of the results came to around a fifth of the fat in the area. Allergan, the maker of CoolSculpting, gives an average of 24 to 27 percent.

Your body clears the dead fat cells over the following weeks, so the change shows slowly and is easiest to see at 3 months.

Before the session

Your first visit starts with a body composition scan and a talk with the doctor. The doctor pinches the area to check that the fat is soft enough to fit in the applicator, marks the spot and takes photos to compare with at 3 months.

Eat normally beforehand and wear loose clothes. You don't need to stop exercising or change your diet.

During the session

A gel pad goes on your skin to protect it and the applicator goes on top. It sucks the fold of fat in and starts to cool it. It feels very cold and tight for the first 5 to 10 minutes, then the area goes numb.

We use CoolSculpting Elite, which cools the fat to between -11 and -13 °C. A sensor system called Freeze Detect watches the skin and protects it from cold injury.

You can read or use your phone for the rest of the session. When the applicator comes off, the area looks firm and pale for a few minutes. The nurse massages it for about 2 minutes to help break up the frozen cells. It can hurt a little, and the maker says the massage adds up to 68 percent to the result.

After the session

You can go back to work, drive and exercise on the same day. Right after, the area can feel tight and look red, bruised or a little swollen. Over the next 1 to 2 weeks it can itch, give sharp pains or feel numb, and the numbness can last a few weeks. After treatment under the chin, the back of your throat can feel full. Most of this goes away within 1 to 2 weeks.

A rare side effect is paradoxical adipose hyperplasia, where the treated fat gets bigger and firmer a few months after the session instead of shrinking. A 2014 report put it at about 1 in 20,000 treatments and later reports have put it higher.

Who it's for

CoolSculpting works best if you're close to your goal weight, have soft fat you can pinch and have a BMI under 35. It takes fat out of one area and won't bring your weight down much. If you also want to lose weight, the doctor may pair it with 1 Week 1 Kilo.

It can't be used if you have hives from cold (cold urticaria), cryoglobulinaemia, cold agglutinin disease, paroxysmal cold haemoglobinuria or a bleeding disorder. You'll need to wait if you're pregnant.

CoolSculpting or liposuction

Liposuction takes out more fat at once. It's surgery done through small cuts under anaesthetic, and you need a week or more to recover and a compression garment after. CoolSculpting takes out less fat per session, but you don't need any time off and the change builds over 3 months. If you want a big change in several areas at once, surgery is usually the better choice.

faq.a: It feels very cold and tight for the first 5 to 10 minutes until the area goes numb. The massage afterwards can sting for about a minute.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: One session is often enough for an area. We suggest a second one 8 to 12 weeks later for a clearer result, and the doctor decides after measuring the fat at your first visit.
The fat cells that were treated are gone for good. The ones left in the area can still get bigger if you gain weight.
Only a little since the fat in one area doesn't weigh much. You'll notice it more in how your clothes fit and in the photos at 3 months.
Yes, on the same day.
Yes. The FDA cleared it for the flanks in 2010 and later added the belly, thighs, upper arms, under the chin, the bra line, the back and under the buttocks.

treatments.name: Emsculpt Neo

tile.page: Heat and magnetic pulses for fat and muscle

bench.desc: Heat and magnetic pulses work on fat and muscle in the same session.

note.h: What Emsculpt Neo does in 30 minutes
note.p: Heat and magnetic pulses work on the fat and the muscle at the same time.

treatments.desc: Emsculpt Neo at Apex Slim and Longevity thins the fat layer and builds the muscle under it in 30-minute sessions.
hook: Emsculpt Neo works on fat and muscle in the same 30-minute session. You lie on a bed while the applicator heats the fat layer with radiofrequency and sends magnetic pulses into the muscle underneath. The pulses make the muscle contract much harder than it can when you work out.

It's for people who want a flatter belly, firmer buttocks or more toned arms and legs and who are already close to a healthy weight. In an MRI study of 41 people, 3 sessions on the belly made the fat layer 30.8 percent thinner and the muscle 26.1 percent thicker after 3 months.

protocol.v: 30 minutes per area
Results start after 2 to 4 and are clearest after 4 to 6, spaced 2 to 3 days apart
Warmth with strong muscle contractions
None, with tired muscles like after a workout
Build over 3 months
BellySides of the waistButtocksFront and back of the thighsInner and outer thighsFront and back of the upper armsCalves

treatments.body:
How it works

Radiofrequency (RF) heats the fat layer until the fat cells are damaged, and your body clears them over the next few weeks. The magnetic pulses, called HIFEM, act directly on the nerve that controls the muscle. A 30-minute session makes the muscle contract about 20,000 times.

The muscle responds the same way it does to heavy training and gets thicker and stronger. The researchers think the RF heat adds to the muscle growth since heat on its own helps muscle grow.

Results from studies

In the MRI study, waists were 5.87 cm smaller on average at 3 months.

A second trial, published in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery in 2022, gave 48 people the real treatment and 24 people a fake one set to 5 percent power. After 3 sessions the treated group had 20.5 percent less belly fat and 21.5 percent more muscle at 1 month, going up to 28.3 percent and 24.2 percent at 3 months. The fake treatment group had no change, and the treated group still had their results at 6 months.

What a session feels like

You lie on a bed and the nurse straps the applicator over the area. Your skin warms up over the first few minutes, then the muscle starts to tighten and relax in strong pulses. The nurse turns the power up as you get used to it and down whenever you ask.

You can go straight back to work. Your muscles may feel tired or sore like after a hard workout.

After pregnancy

During pregnancy the two sides of the main belly muscle stretch apart. In many women the gap stays wider after giving birth, which is called diastasis recti, and the belly still sticks out after the weight is gone. In the MRI study the gap was 18.8 percent narrower 3 months after treatment.

Wait until your own doctor says you can exercise again after giving birth. A wide gap may still need physiotherapy or surgery, and our doctor will check it at your consult.

When you'll see a change

Results usually start to show after 2 to 4 sessions and are clearest after 4 to 6. In the studies, the results for both fat and muscle were biggest at 3 months.

Who it's for

Emsculpt Neo is for people who want more muscle but don't see it from exercise, mothers who want their belly muscle back after giving birth, people with no time for the gym, and anyone after a six-pack, lines down the belly or firmer buttocks. An applicator called Edge treats the sides of the waist, where fat is hard to shift.

It works best if you're close to a healthy weight. It only takes fat out of the area being treated, so it won't replace weight loss if you have a lot to lose.

It can't be used if you're pregnant, have a pacemaker or another electronic implant, or have metal implants in or near the area.

faq.a: The contractions are strong and the area gets warm. The nurse can turn it down any time you ask.
It makes the muscle thicker and the fat over it thinner. How much of the muscle shows depends on how much fat you had to begin with.

faq.q: How long do the results last?
faq.a: In the trial they were still there at 6 months. Muscle you don't use gets smaller over time, so keep exercising to hold on to the result.

faq.q: Can I combine it with CoolSculpting?
faq.a: Yes. CoolSculpting removes more fat from thicker areas and Emsculpt Neo builds the muscle underneath.

treatments.name: FIT FIRM

tile.page: Radiofrequency for cellulite and firmer skin

bench.desc: Radiofrequency warms the layer under the skin to smooth cellulite and firm loose skin.

note.p: Radiofrequency warms the layer under the skin and makes it build new collagen.

treatments.desc: FIT FIRM at Apex Slim and Longevity uses 448 kHz radiofrequency to smooth cellulite and firm loose skin in about 20 minutes a session.
hook: FIT FIRM is our program for cellulite and loose skin. Cellulite is the dimpled, orange-peel skin that shows most on the thighs, hips and buttocks, and it often stays after losing weight or having a baby even when the rest of you has slimmed down.

FIT FIRM uses a radiofrequency (RF) handpiece at 448 kHz to warm the layer under your skin. The heat helps break down stored fat there and makes your skin build new collagen and elastin over the next few months. Each session takes about 20 minutes with no needles and no downtime.

protocol.v: Continuous monopolar radiofrequency at 448 kHz
About 20 minutes, longer for several areas
A change from the first, clearer after 4 to 6, best after 8 to 10
Warmth with a light pull, like a massage
None
Front and back of the thighsHips and buttocksBellyUpper armsInner kneesBackWaist

treatments.body:
What causes cellulite

Under the skin, fat sits in small pockets held in place by bands of collagen that run down to the muscle. When the pockets fill up, the fat pushes up between the bands while the bands hold the skin down, and the surface looks dimpled. Women get cellulite far more often than men since their bands run straight up toward the skin.

Diet and exercise help by shrinking the fat in the pockets, but the bands and the skin over them stay the same. FIT FIRM works on the skin and the layer under it.

How the heat works

The handpiece sends radiofrequency energy into the skin at 448 kHz, and the tissue under the skin warms up. The collagen already there tightens and the warmth signals your skin cells to make new collagen and elastin. New collagen takes weeks to months to form, so your skin keeps getting smoother and firmer after the course ends.

Your session

  1. You talk with the doctor or our Slim specialist team, who look at your shape and the areas you want treated and plan your course.
  2. The skin over the area is cleaned.
  3. A gel goes on the skin to help the energy pass through.
  4. The handpiece is moved over the area with a light massage. It feels warm with a light pull.
  5. After about 20 minutes you can go straight back to your day.

How many sessions

Most people see a change after the first session, a clear change after 4 to 6 and the best result after 8 to 10. How far you get depends on your skin, the number of sessions and how you look after your skin between them.

Who it's for

FIT FIRM is for cellulite and mildly loose skin on the thighs, hips, buttocks, belly, upper arms, inner knees, back or waist, including skin that loosened after pregnancy or weight loss. The front and back of the thighs are the most common areas. Very loose skin after a big weight loss may need surgery to remove, and the doctor will tell you at your consult if FIT FIRM can't give you the result you want.

It can't be used if you're pregnant, have a pacemaker or another electronic implant, have metal implants in the area, or have an infection or open wound on the skin there.

faq.a: FIT FIRM uses heat to smooth cellulite and firm the skin. Emsculpt Neo adds magnetic pulses that work the muscle and is made to remove fat and build muscle.

note.p: Vitamin C by drip reaches levels in the blood that tablets can't.

treatments.desc: IV therapy at Apex Slim and Longevity gives you vitamins, minerals and fluids by drip in 30 to 60 minutes.
hook: An IV drip puts vitamins, minerals and fluid straight into your blood. Vitamins you take by mouth go through your gut first, and your body can only absorb so much at a time.

A study at the US National Institutes of Health gave people 1.25 g of vitamin C by drip and by mouth. The drip raised the level in the blood to 885 µmol/L at its peak, more than six times the 135 µmol/L from swallowing it. A drip helps after fluid loss and for a proven lack of a vitamin, while the evidence for energy, recovery and skin is thin.

treatments.body:
When a drip helps

A drip replaces fluid and salts quickly after vomiting, diarrhoea, heavy sweating or a fever, when it's hard to drink enough. It also treats a proven lack of a vitamin or mineral, especially in people whose gut doesn't absorb well, like after weight-loss surgery or with a bowel condition. There is strong medical evidence for these uses.

Where the evidence is thin

People also come in for drips for energy, to recover after a long flight or a hard week, or for their skin. A lot of them say they feel better afterwards, but few large trials have compared a real drip with a fake one, so nobody knows yet how much it helps healthy people. Doctors at Cleveland Clinic say its value as a general wellness treatment is uncertain.

No good studies show yet that a drip removes toxins or slows ageing.

What's in the drip

The base is saline with salts called electrolytes. The doctor adds the vitamins and minerals for your goal, most often B vitamins, vitamin C, magnesium and zinc, and decides the dose after your health check.

The Drip B-A-R menu

Our drips go by the name Drip B-A-R. Our doctors made the formulas and adjust them for each person, and the menu has 12 drips.

The 12 drips on the Drip B-A-R menu

Ask the doctor what's in a drip before you book where the menu doesn't list it. A blood test shows whether you're low in a vitamin, and the doctor uses it to pick the drip. EDTA is the drip used in hospitals for lead poisoning, and the doctor checks your kidneys and calcium before giving it since it can affect both.

Your visit

The doctor asks about your health and any medicines you take and checks your blood pressure. A nurse puts a thin tube into a vein in your arm, and the drip runs for 30 to 60 minutes while you sit and read or use your phone. You can go back to your day as soon as the tube comes out.

Risks

  • bruising, soreness or swelling where the needle went in
  • irritation of the vein
  • infection where the needle went in, which is rare when it's done cleanly
  • getting too much of a vitamin or mineral, or salts going out of balance
  • too much fluid for people with heart or kidney disease

Tell the doctor first

Tell the doctor before your first drip if you have heart disease, kidney disease or high blood pressure, or if you're pregnant or breastfeeding.

G6PD deficiency is common in Thailand. In people who have it, a high dose of vitamin C by drip can break down red blood cells, so the doctor may test you for it first.

faq.q: How often can I have one?
faq.a: It depends on your goal and your blood tests. A drip for dehydration is often a one-off. For a vitamin deficiency you'll have a course of drips until your levels are back to normal.

faq.q: Is a drip better than taking vitamins?
faq.a: If you're healthy and eat well, food and tablets give you what you need every day. A drip helps when you need fluid fast, when your gut can't absorb enough, or when the doctor wants a higher level than tablets can give.
It stings a little when the needle goes in, and the fluid can feel cold in your arm.
Yes. You can drive and go back to work as soon as it's done.

bench.desc: You breathe pure oxygen in a pressurised chamber, which raises the oxygen carried in your blood.

treatments.longCard: You breathe pure oxygen in a pressurised chamber for 60 minutes, which raises the oxygen carried in your blood.

note.h: How pressure puts more oxygen in your blood
note.p: Breathing pure oxygen under pressure pushes extra oxygen into the plasma.

treatments.desc: HBOT at Apex Slim and Longevity: you breathe pure oxygen in a pressurised chamber for 60 minutes.
hook: In hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) you breathe pure oxygen inside a chamber at 2 to 3 times normal air pressure. Hospitals use it to treat divers with decompression sickness and to help wounds that won't heal.

Almost all the oxygen in your blood is carried by your red blood cells, and they're already close to full. The pressure in the chamber pushes extra oxygen into the plasma, the liquid part of your blood. At about 2.4 times normal pressure the plasma carries about 5 to 6 mL of oxygen in every 100 mL of blood, compared with about 0.3 mL at normal pressure.

2 to 3 times normal air pressure
Pure oxygen through a mask or hood
Ear pressure like a plane coming in to land, then quiet
None
A doctor checks your ears, lungs and medicines

treatments.body:
How pressure adds oxygen

Your red blood cells are about 97 percent full of oxygen when you breathe normal air. The higher the pressure, the more extra oxygen dissolves into the plasma.

Hospitals use HBOT on difficult wounds since oxygen in the plasma can reach places that red blood cells have trouble getting to, like swollen tissue and the edges of a wound.

What it's approved for

The US FDA has cleared hyperbaric chambers for a list of conditions. These include decompression sickness, air bubbles in the blood, carbon monoxide poisoning, burns, severe infections, slow-healing diabetic wounds, radiation injury and severe anaemia when a blood transfusion isn't possible. For wounds, hospitals give sessions of 1.5 to 2 hours every day for 20 to 40 days.

HBOT for wellness and recovery

At Apex Slim we offer HBOT as a 60-minute session for people who sleep badly, feel worn out from work, train hard or are recovering from surgery, and for people who want to slow the effects of ageing. None of these is on the FDA list. The main study on this, done in Israel, gave 35 adults aged 64 and over 60 sessions at 2 times normal pressure over 3 months.

Telomeres are the caps on the ends of your chromosomes, and they get shorter as you age. In the study they got more than 20 percent longer in several types of immune cell, and worn-out helper T cells went down by 37 percent.

The study was small and had no comparison group. It also only measured blood cells, so we still don't know what HBOT does to ageing in the rest of the body. The FDA warns against centres that say HBOT can cure conditions it isn't cleared for.

Your session

  1. Change into cotton clothes. Phones, lighters, hand warmers, lotion and hair oil have to stay outside since pure oxygen under pressure is a fire risk.
  2. The door closes and the pressure goes up over a few minutes. Your ears will feel full like when a plane is landing. Swallow, yawn, or pinch your nose and blow gently to clear them.
  3. You breathe pure oxygen through a mask or hood for the rest of the session. You can rest or sleep.
  4. The pressure goes down slowly at the end and your ears may pop again. You can go back to your day straight after.

Side effects

  • ear pain or pressure from the pressure change, which is the most common problem
  • sinus pain, more likely if you have a cold
  • blurry distance vision that builds up over many sessions and goes back to normal after you finish
  • feeling closed in if you don't like small spaces
  • a seizure caused by the oxygen, which is rare at about 1 to 4 in every 10,000 treatments

You can't have HBOT if you have a collapsed lung that hasn't been treated. The doctor will also ask about any recent ear or chest surgery and the medicines you take before your first session. If you have a bad cold or a blocked nose, you'll need to wait until it clears.

faq.a: Your ears can hurt for a moment as the pressure goes up if they don't clear, and the staff can slow the pressure down for you. After that it's like sitting in a quiet room.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: The doctor decides based on your goal. The study on ageing used 60 sessions over 3 months.

faq.q: Is it the same as breathing oxygen from a tank?
faq.a: No. At normal pressure, oxygen from a tank only tops up red blood cells that are already nearly full. You need the pressure in the chamber to get the extra oxygen into your plasma.
No. Phones and other electronics have to stay outside since a spark is dangerous in pure oxygen.

faq.q: I don't like small spaces. Can I still do it?
faq.a: Tell the doctor at your consult. The staff stay in contact with you the whole time and can stop the session if you need to come out.

treatments.desc: Snorelase at Apex Slim and Longevity is a laser treatment for snoring, about 30 minutes a session with no cuts and no anaesthetic.
hook: Snorelase is a laser treatment for snoring. You snore when the soft palate and the tissue at the back of your throat flap as air passes through while you sleep. The laser heats that tissue without cutting it, and the tissue tightens and flaps less.

In a 2022 trial, 40 people who snored got either 3 sessions with the same type of laser or a fake treatment. Their bed partners rated the snoring of the laser group at 7.9 out of 10 before treatment and 4.7 after, while the fake treatment group stayed at 8.

None needed

treatments.body:
Why you snore

When you fall asleep, the muscles in your throat relax and the soft palate, the uvula and the tissue around them sag into your airway. Air going through the smaller gap makes the loose tissue flap and make the snoring sound. Snoring gets worse with age, alcohol, sleeping on your back and extra weight around the neck.

How the laser works

Snorelase uses an erbium laser (Er:YAG) in a mode that heats without cutting. Short pulses warm the lining of your mouth and throat without breaking the surface. The heat makes the collagen in the tissue shrink and tighten and starts new collagen growing over the next few weeks. Firmer tissue flaps less, so you snore more quietly, and imaging studies have measured a wider airway after treatment. Our doctor treats the soft palate, the inside of the cheeks and the base of the tongue.

Results from studies

The people in the 2022 trial didn't have significant sleep apnoea, and the fake treatment used a handpiece that blocked the laser. People rated the discomfort 3 out of 10 on average. Nobody needed an anaesthetic and there were no complications.

A review of 7 studies with 247 patients found that 80 percent were happy with the result. A review from 2025 found that the effect usually lasts 12 to 24 months, and 25 to 40 percent of people needed a top-up session to keep it. Another study of 40 patients treated with an Er:YAG laser at 2940 nm found that 97 percent were satisfied.

Snoring or sleep apnoea

Snoring can be a sign of obstructive sleep apnoea, where your airway closes completely and you stop breathing many times a night. Ask a doctor about a sleep test first if:

  • someone has seen you stop breathing or gasp in your sleep
  • you feel sleepy during the day after a full night in bed
  • you wake up with headaches
  • you have high blood pressure

In the review of 7 studies, snoring got quieter but the number of times people stopped breathing stayed about the same. Snorelase treats snoring and can't replace treatment for sleep apnoea.

We also treat people who already use a CPAP machine for sleep apnoea and still snore. Keep using the CPAP since the laser doesn't treat the apnoea itself.

Your sessions

You sit in the chair with safety glasses on, and the doctor moves the laser over your soft palate, the inside of your cheeks and the base of your tongue. Each session takes about 30 minutes and feels warm. You can eat and go back to work straight after, and your throat may feel dry or scratchy for a day or so.

Most people need 3 to 6 sessions. The doctor will tell you how far apart to book them.

Who it's for

Snorelase is for adults who snore because of a loose soft palate and throat. Snoring from a blocked nose or large tonsils needs a different treatment, and the doctor checks for both at your first visit.

Other ways to snore less

Some people snore less with a few simple changes. Try sleeping on your side, drinking less alcohol in the evening and losing weight if you carry extra weight around the neck. A mouth guard that holds your lower jaw forward while you sleep can also help. Surgery on the soft palate is the option when nothing else works, and a CPAP machine is the standard treatment for sleep apnoea.

faq.a: It feels warm. People in the trial rated it 3 out of 10 and none of them needed an anaesthetic.
Some couples notice a change after the first session. The full effect builds up over the course as new collagen forms.
Usually 12 to 24 months. You can book a top-up session when the snoring starts to come back.

faq.q: My partner says I stop breathing at night.
faq.a: Get a sleep test before you book Snorelase since stopping breathing is a sign of sleep apnoea, which needs its own treatment.
